A claim that needs support[^src].

A second claim[^other], and then the first claim again[^src]. The atom
renderer numbers a footnote by the order of its first reference, so [^src]
is 1 and [^other] is 2 however often either is repeated.

[^src]: The supporting note, which itself holds a
    [link](https://example.com/c).

[^other]: A second footnote, with *emphasis* in it.
